btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.detail: Verified: soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch exist in the catalog but were absent from the btts record. SOCCER_a.json btts_and_clean_sheet: both added to stage s1 (per-side lambda) with cross-division cup text (Copa del Rey, Copa do Brasil, Coupe de France, FA Cup, DFB-Pokal, Israeli Cup), a conditional interaction with soc.team_fail_to_score_propensity, a required_data entry feeding both, and talent/availability coverage. competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.detail: Verified: neither soc.transfers nor soc.manager_dismissal_hazard was staged in competition_head_to_head. Added both to stage s4 (in-horizon dismissal drawn per simulated week, rating re-blend w(m)=6/(6+m)), plus a regime-switch interaction with soc.comp_sim. coaching_scheme coverage went from GAP to COVERED. Patched the soc.transfers measurement (input_patches/SOCCER_a.json) because its old manager re-blend text was not an exact calculation. Shift size is still left to the event study.

first_half_and_period#gap_environment.detail: Verified: soc.weather was not attached to first_half_and_period and environment coverage was GAP. Added soc.weather to the half-split stage s2 with a threshold interaction soc.weather x soc.period_split (heat index/altitude shifting the 2H share), a kickoff-weather required_data entry, and environment set to COVERED. Patched the soc.weather measurement to add heat index, altitude and a second-half-share regression, and gave it raw_data (it had none). Effect size is still empirical.

first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.detail: After the orchestrator remap (universe/SOCCER_zblk.json; the gate now shows 32 FTTS series in first_to_score_event and 41 in the knockout key), first_to_score_event was rewritten as FTTS only. Changes: settlement, summary and variants cover FTTS alone; the Method stages s2 (the duplicate) and s7 are removed; the stages are now intensities, first-goal hazard/route, an extra-time race window and settlement; MOV interactions, the nonlinearity and the margin dataset are dropped; archetype_patches/SOCCER_a.json detaches soc.method_path_tree_calibration and soc.winning_margin_distribution and sets target/contract_types. unreg:knockout_method_of_victory is now PARTIALLY_VERIFIED over 41 series, with NO_LISTING variants, stage s6 (non-final, two-leg and straight-to-penalties ties), conditional league-MOV stage s7, a two-leg interaction, a cup dataset and u3 rewritten. Residual: the catalog keeps the old MOV interactions copied earlier, because integrate never removes them.

relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.detail: Verified: soc.transfers and soc.manager_dismissal_hazard were absent. Added both to stage s2 (remaining-fixture simulation draws bottom-six dismissals from simulated winless runs, then applies the re-blended rating), plus a regime-switch interaction with soc.comp_sim. coaching_scheme went from GAP to COVERED. The soc.transfers measurement is patched to an exact re-blend. Bounce magnitude is held at 0 until the event study.

relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.detail: Checked online: the reviewer's 3rd-6th EFL format is out of date. The EFL confirmed in March 2026 that from 2026-27, the season KXEFLPROMO covers, the play-offs run 3rd-8th: single-leg eliminators 5v8 and 6v7 at the higher seed, two-legged semis against 3rd/4th, Wembley final. Segunda (KXLALIGA2PROMO): 3v6/4v5, two-legged semis and final; a level aggregate after extra time goes to the better-placed side, with no away goals or shootout since 2022. Added new input soc.promotion_relegation_playoff_bracket (full definition, composed from tie_advancement_state_tree and extra_time_shootout_model) to stage s3, plus a piecewise interaction and a data feed. Still open: the EFL semi pairing and final details.

The gap text is updated; Source Agencies stays undefined.

team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.detail: Verified: neither input was staged. total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.detail: Verified: total_goals staged no stakes or rotation input. Added soc.stakes_leverage and soc.rotation_index to the lambda stage s1, plus a conditional interaction (leverage regime x realised rotation x ratings, unknown sign, tested by pooled residual regression). Fed them from the results dataset (standings/remaining fixtures) and the lineups dataset (previous-match XI). situational_schedule_motivation went from GAP to COVERED. The sign and size of the effect stay empirical.
